def build_truss(sandbox, start_x, end_x, deck_y, bottom_y, num_panels, deck_density=3.5, truss_density=2.5):
    gap_width = end_x - start_x
    panel_width = gap_width / num_panels
    truss_depth = deck_y - bottom_y

    deck_beams = []
    bottom_beams = []

    # Create deck beams
    for i in range(num_panels):
        cx = start_x + (i + 0.5) * panel_width
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=cx, y=deck_y, width=panel_width, height=0.4, density=deck_density, friction=0.7)
        deck_beams.append(b)

    # Connect adjacent deck panels with rigid joints for a smooth deck
    for i in range(num_panels - 1):
        x_anchor = start_x + (i + 1) * panel_width
        sandbox.add_joint(deck_beams[i], deck_beams[i + 1], (x_anchor, deck_y), type='rigid')

    # Create bottom beams
    for i in range(num_panels):
        cx = start_x + (i + 0.5) * panel_width
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=cx, y=bottom_y, width=panel_width, height=0.4, density=truss_density, friction=0.7)
        bottom_beams.append(b)

    # Connect bottom beams with pivot joints
    for i in range(num_panels - 1):
        anchor_x = start_x + (i + 1) * panel_width
        sandbox.add_joint(bottom_beams[i], bottom_beams[i + 1], (anchor_x, bottom_y), type='pivot')

    # Add vertical supports with pivot joints
    for i in range(num_panels):
        x = start_x + i * panel_width
        y = (deck_y + bottom_y) / 2
        v_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=x, y=y, width=0.3, height=truss_depth, density=truss_density, friction=0.7)
        sandbox.add_joint(v_beam, deck_beams[i], (x, deck_y), type='pivot')
        sandbox.add_joint(v_beam, bottom_beams[i], (x, bottom_y), type='pivot')

    # Add X-bracing diagonals with pivot joints
    for i in range(num_panels):
        x_start = start_x + i * panel_width
        x_end = start_x + (i + 1) * panel_width
        d1_length = math.hypot(panel_width, truss_depth)
        d1_angle = math.atan2(-truss_depth, panel_width)
        d1 = sandbox.add_beam(x=(x_start + x_end) / 2, y=(deck_y + bottom_y) / 2,
                              width=d1_length, height=0.3, angle=d1_angle, density=truss_density, friction=0.7)
        sandbox.add_joint(d1, deck_beams[i], (x_start, deck_y), type='pivot')
        sandbox.add_joint(d1, bottom_beams[i], (x_end, bottom_y), type='pivot')

        d2 = sandbox.add_beam(x=(x_start + x_end) / 2, y=(deck_y + bottom_y) / 2,
                              width=d1_length, height=0.3, angle=d2_angle, density=truss_density, friction=0.7)
        sandbox.add_joint(d2, deck_beams[i], (x_end, deck_y), type='pivot')
